Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

## The role

Collaborating closely with our dynamic team of product designers and engineers, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the foundation of frontend at Helsing. Embracing a hands-on approach, you'll not only lead by example, but also spearhead the development and expansion of a tight-knit team that works across a wide-range of internal teams and products. Your primary emphasis will be on enhancing usability, creating re-usable foundations for multiple front-ends and optimising the end-user experience across the entire company.

# Senior Frontend Developer (f/m/d)

Remote Germany, Berlin, Hamburg, München, Prague

Full-time

Permanent employee

## What to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. 

Responsibility

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

As a developer at EvidentIQ, you embody a strong **hands-on mentality** and a **can-do attitude**. You are a reliable partner and mentor for other developers, embrace a test-driven (or even behavior-driven) development approach, and promote an open DevOps work environment.

As a developer at EvidentIQ, you have a real impact on our products and our emerging architecture.

* More than 5 years of experience in developing modern web applications using frameworks such as Vue.js (preferred), Angular, or React
